notice: PROPOSAL, not reviewed. Every lead time, staff effort, external party waited on, multiplicity and resource capacity is a PROVISIONAL ASSUMPTION (config/assumptions.yaml: value, basis, owner); none is stated in the tender pack. Earliest dates come from a forward pass from the planning date (the latest addendum's issue date), latest dates from a backward pass in Working Days (VOL-I 2.4) from the pack's dates; negative float is INFEASIBLE, never compressed. Timing, decision readiness and resource feasibility are separate statuses; resource levelling is NOT implemented; overloads are reported, not resolved. No bidder references, certificates, attendance or financial standing are assumed to exist.
planning_basis: Planning date 2026-11-05 = the issue date of ADD-03, the latest addendum at this stage (owner's instruction: the latest addendum date is the planning date). Earliest dates: a forward pass in Working Days (VOL-I 2.4: Sunday to Thursday, declared holidays excluded; holidays configured: none) from the first Working Day on or after the planning date (2026-11-05). Latest dates: a backward pass from the pack deadlines in force at ADD-03 (ATTENDANCE-NOTICE 2026-10-14; CLARIFICATION-CUTOFF 2026-11-19; PDD 2026-12-10 14:00). Total float = Working Days from earliest start to latest start; negative float = INFEASIBLE by that many Working Days (never compressed). Proposal Due Date at this stage: 2026-12-10.
